title: Momoi Airi — Special Free Time Snapshot!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Warmth of a Guiding Hand

rows.Line: Aboard a train

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
It's still gonna take a while to get where we're going.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(I know.
Maybe we could use this time to see if that schedule I shared with everyone yesterday looks okay.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, every—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I was hoping that we could check over that schedule I sent you all yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I guess these two can't right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're fast asleep.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We have been pretty busy lately.
I'd rather not wake then, so maybe we can look over our schedule after we get to the inn.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, it's a shame that they're sleeping instead of seeing this beautiful scenery...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right!
It's so beautiful... Nothing but green as far as the eye can see...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've gotta post a picture of this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hmm... What should I go for? More of a full landscape or a pic that includes the window to let everyone know we're traveling...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, or a shot of our reflections in the—)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi, look this way for me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, hey! You could've warned me before taking that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I thought everyone online would like seeing us in our natural state.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I get what you mean...
But submit it for approval first. Idols still have to be idols even in their “natural state”!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Submit it for approval...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, you're not posting that.
Our next one's gonna look a lot better. So, Haruka, smile!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, one second. Ready?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, not bad!
Let's go with this one!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since we're uploading both, I'll also send you the other one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, I said we're not uploading that one!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh... We got another email for work.
Come to think of it, we still have a few that we haven't replied to yet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Need any help?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for offering, but I'm okay for now. I'll just reply to the most urgent ones.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That being said, it has been getting hard lately to actually deal with everything all on our own.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (As nice as it is that we're getting all these offers, dealing with scheduling has been hard on all of us...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (So, we really could use a manager.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Anyway, I'm gonna reply to all the emails that need my attention right now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi, are you all finished?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, for now.
Were you reading a book just now, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, it's a novel that one of our fans recommended. I was hoping to share my thoughts on it during a stream in the future.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, a novel...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm pretty close to finishing it, so want to borrow it once I'm done? It's actually pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I am interested, but I'll pass for now.
Reading for too long on a moving train might make me sick.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Haruka, do you not get motion sickness or anything? You seemed pretty focused just now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, now that you mention it, I don't really get motion sickness or anything. Even when I was still in ASRUN, I read scripts during our rides over...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I remember going through fan mail while on buses for shoots. That usually gave me all the motivation I needed to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow... I guess that means your inner ear's tough to agitate.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Still, it's really like her to think of her fans even during a bus ride.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Um, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not letting you hog the spotlight during this shoot!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I wouldn't want you to.
Let's make it a good one.
